status: Local CPU research only; P2 product integration and H20/L20 measurements not performed.

environment.note: CPU software differs from deployed Python3.10/NumPy1.26.4/SciPy1.11.4; no H20/L20 dataset was used.

grid.rng_note: Historical adapter supplied one pre-generated roll array; its query body consumed no RNG. Portable runner restores same RNG before direct production calls and compares their after states. Portable runner was only syntax/import checked, not re-benchmarked.

candidate_threads.scope: Old KDTree plus compiled FPS; whole candidate chunks of64; not composed with grid; phase timers are sums of worker durations, not wall.

voxel_heads.scope: one synthetic CPU float64 algebra/gradient comparison; no CUDA speed or AMP claim
voxel_heads.scope_detail: Joint CPU float64 algebra comparison includes no-instance fusion/q0 reuse and optional axis-first-affine split, raw-point synthetic weighted squared loss and seed feature path. Not full production loss, CUDA AMP equivalence, or speed.
checked_components: optional axis first-affine split with pointwise observed normals, before axis geometry
voxel_heads.objective: synthetic weighted q0 squared error plus squared seed features and pregeometry axis ab; not production source_losses

limitations: One synthetic height-field scene is not a real SuctionNet pile; two repeats have cold/warm variation.
Standalone ball-query comparison retained all result arrays; complete grouping released results per candidate.
Initial temporary adapter replaced only roll input/timing return boundary; local geometry math, point set and FPS remained production code.
Do not multiply grid/thread/async-index/local-MLP speedups or advertise them as total training acceleration.
Existing four-real-frame paired comparison, normal resume and20-30 budgeted updates are proposed integration acceptance, not completed P2 results.
